image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a wet, rocky substrate. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal shell plates embedded in a thick, textured girdle. The anterior end is visible at the bottom left, showing a blunt head region without eyes or tentacles. The posterior end curves towards the top right. The surrounding environment includes dark, wet rock and some marine debris or algae.
